name: AP_BATCHES_ALL
description: AP_BATCHES_ALL contains summary information about invoices you enter in batches if you enable the Batch Control Payables option.  There is one row for each batch of invoices you enter.  If you enable Batch Control, each invoice must correspond to a record in this table. Your Oracle Payables application uses this information to group together invoices that one person entered in a batch. This table corresponds to the Invoice Batches window.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique invoice group identifier.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Invoice batch name (uniqueness enforced by the Invoice workbench)

columns.name: BATCH_DATE
columns.description: Date when invoice batch was created.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONTROL_INVOICE_COUNT
columns.description: User entered control of number of invoices in batch

columns.name: CONTROL_INVOICE_TOTAL
columns.description: User entered control of invoice amount total for invoices in batch

columns.name: ACTUAL_INVOICE_COUNT
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: ACTUAL_INVOICE_TOTAL
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of invoice, overrides supplier invoice currency (may be left null for Multiple Currency Batches)

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of payment (must be an associated fixed-rate currency or same as INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE)

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Name of pay group.  This value overrides supplier pay group

columns.name: BATCH_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Accounting Flexfield identifier for accounts payable liability account, overrides supplier liability account

columns.name: TERMS_ID
columns.description: Terms identifier, overrides supplier pay group

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
